nodes.title: SG-6.1 · Add a listExecutions admin client function
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/api/client.ts already has adminRequest, getCurrentRound, approveExecution, retryExecution and the ExecutionInfo type, but nothing calls GET /api/v1/admin/executions. Desired behavior: add listExecutions and a current-Round ExecutionInfo lookup, covered by a unit test with mocked fetch. Why: the admin console needs execution data to show Round progress.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an admin token, when listExecutions is called, then GET /api/v1/admin/executions is requested with a Bearer Authorization header and the parsed ExecutionInfo array is returned
- Given executions for several rounds, when the current-Round lookup runs, then the ExecutionInfo whose round_id equals the current Round id is returned, or undefined when none matches
- Given a mocked fetch, when the unit tests run, then they pass without any network access


## Scope
- In scope: listExecutions in client.ts
- In scope: current-Round ExecutionInfo lookup in client.ts
- In scope: unit test with mocked fetch
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: AdminApp UI wiring
- Out of scope: New endpoints
- Preserve: Existing client.ts exports and behavior
- Preserve: ApiError handling in readJSON


## Technical constraints
- Reuse adminRequest and ExecutionInfo
- Endpoint is GET /api/v1/admin/executions (backend/internal/server/server.go)


## Definition of done
- Both functions exported from client.ts
- Unit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · listExecutions calls GET /api/v1/admin/executions with the admin token
nodes.body:
Context: backend execution.Handler.List responds 200 with a JSON array of executions ([] when empty). Desired behavior: client.ts exports listExecutions(token) built on adminRequest. Expected result: callers receive ExecutionInfo[] or an ApiError on non-2xx. Why: admin console needs the list.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given token T, when listExecutions(T) is called, then fetch receives /api/v1/admin/executions with header Authorization: Bearer T and no POST method
- Given a 401 response, when listExecutions is called, then it rejects with an ApiError whose status is 401


## Scope
- In scope: listExecutions
- Out of scope: Backend
- Preserve: adminRequest signature


## Technical constraints
- No world query param: the list handler takes none


## Definition of done
- listExecutions exported


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Lookup returns the ExecutionInfo for the current Round
nodes.body:
Context: Executions carry round_id; the public current Round comes from getCurrentRound. Desired behavior: a pure findExecutionForRound(list, roundId) and an async getCurrentRoundExecution(token, worldId) that composes them. Expected result: the matching ExecutionInfo, newest by updated_at when several match, else undefined. Why: the admin console shows the current Round's execution.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given executions for round-1 and round-2 and current round round-1, when getCurrentRoundExecution runs, then the round-1 execution is returned
- Given no execution for the current round, when it runs, then undefined is returned
- Given two executions for the current round, when it runs, then the one with the later updated_at is returned


## Scope
- In scope: findExecutionForRound
- In scope: getCurrentRoundExecution
- Out of scope: UI wiring
- Preserve: getCurrentRound behavior


## Technical constraints
- updated_at is RFC 3339 so string comparison orders it


## Definition of done
- Both functions exported


## Clarifying questions
- None
